SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
FROM product_variants pv
JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(pv.brand)) = LOWER(TRIM(:brand))
  AND LOWER(TRIM(pv.series)) = LOWER(TRIM(:series))
  AND LOWER(TRIM(pv.model)) = LOWER(TRIM(:model))
  AND LOWER(TRIM(pk.product_kind_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(:product_line))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp
    WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku
      AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_key)) = 'color_family'
      AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_value_text)) = LOWER(TRIM(:color_family))
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp
    WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku
      AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_key)) = 'size'
      AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_value_text)) = LOWER(TRIM(:size))
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp
    WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku
      AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_key)) = 'fit'
      AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_value_text)) = LOWER(TRIM(:fit))
  );
